steps.name: QC and library-size assessment
steps.question: What are the library sizes and count distributions across the 12 liver samples (6 high-fat diet vs 6 chow), and how does sample_01's library size compare to the cohort?
acceptance_criteria: Per-sample library size (total counts) reported for all 12 samples
sample_01 confirmed as an outlier (~4x below median) with a quantified fold-difference
Gene detection rate (genes with count>0) reported per sample
A clear recommendation on whether sample_01 should be dropped or retained with a size-factor caveat, based on the observed magnitude

steps.name: DESeq2 differential expression: HFD vs chow (all 12 samples)
steps.question: Which genes are differentially expressed between high-fat-diet and chow mouse liver samples (6 vs 6, unpaired, single batch, raw Salmon gene counts) using all 12 samples?
acceptance_criteria: DESeq2 run on raw counts.csv (12000 genes x 12 samples) against metadata.csv condition column, with high-fat-diet vs chow as the contrast
Output table with log2FoldChange, p-value, and BH-adjusted p-value for all genes
Significant genes reported at padj < 0.05 with |log2FC| threshold stated explicitly
sample_01's low library size is noted as a caveat on this run's size factors, not silently absorbed
MA plot or size-factor diagnostic included to show sample_01's influence

steps.name: Sensitivity DE: HFD vs chow excluding sample_01
steps.question: Do the differentially expressed genes between high-fat-diet and chow liver change materially when the shallow-library sample_01 is excluded (5 vs 6 or 6 vs 5 comparison, whichever arm sample_01 belongs to)?
acceptance_criteria: DESeq2 rerun on the same counts/metadata with sample_01 removed
Overlap of significant gene sets (padj<0.05) between the full-cohort and sample_01-excluded runs reported (e.g., Jaccard or simple overlap count)
Any genes whose significance call flips reported explicitly
Conclusion stated on whether sample_01 materially changes the DE result

steps.name: Hallmark pathway enrichment (GSEA) on HFD vs chow ranking
steps.question: Which of the 50 MSigDB hallmark pathways are enriched among genes changing between high-fat-diet and chow mouse liver, using the full-cohort DESeq2 ranking?
acceptance_criteria: Genes from T1S2 ranked by a signed statistic (e.g., Wald stat or sign(log2FC)*-log10(pvalue))
Pre-ranked GSEA run against the MSigDB mouse hallmark gene set collection (mouse gene symbols, MGI)
Normalized enrichment score, p-value, and FDR reported per hallmark pathway
Significant pathways (FDR<0.25 per standard GSEA convention, or a stricter threshold if stated) listed with direction (up in HFD vs down)
If the mouse hallmark gene set reference is unavailable at run time, the step reports that gap explicitly rather than substituting a human gene set

steps.name: Hallmark pathway enrichment on sample_01-excluded ranking
steps.question: Are the hallmark pathway calls from T2S1 stable when the DE ranking is recomputed without the shallow sample_01?
acceptance_criteria: Pre-ranked GSEA run against the same MSigDB mouse hallmark gene sets using the T1S3 (sample_01-excluded) ranking
Significant hallmark pathways compared side-by-side with T2S1's results
Pathways that appear/disappear between the two rankings flagged explicitly

plan.title: HFD vs chow mouse liver DE + hallmark pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: Raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples) with mouse gene symbols are QC'd and normalized, flagging sample_01 whose library size is ~4x below median before it can distort size-factor estimation or a downstream DE call. DESeq2 tests high-fat-diet vs chow (6 vs 6, unpaired, single batch) to get the differential expression gene list. The DE result (ranked by Wald statistic) is then fed into a pre-ranked GSEA against the MSigDB mouse hallmark gene sets (48 sets, MGI symbols, staged locally) to identify which hallmark pathways shift with diet. A sensitivity step reruns DE with sample_01 excluded to confirm the DE and pathway calls are not artifacts of that one shallow sample.
